findings.detail: The source identifies the position as Preferred Units, so the non-preferred/common-equity classification is wrong while the 8.00% interest rate is valid.

rationale: Class 2 localization. The source schedule row explicitly names OneTeam Partners, LLC as Preferred Units and places 8.00% in both the reference-rate/spread and interest-rate fields. X01 therefore exposes a real classification defect, not a bad interest-rate value: the holding must not be treated as non-preferred/common equity.
